# TheFangs AI Recruitment

> Official public page for TheFangs research group recruitment at the Faculty of Information Technology, University of Science, VNU-HCM.

## About

- TheFangs currently has 5 members and plans to recruit 5 additional members.
- The group works primarily online and offers research mentoring. GPU support depends on project needs and available resources.
- Research topics include multi-agent AI, foundation model alignment, trustworthy machine learning, continual learning, online learning, and computer vision.
- Long-term pathways may include PhD preparation or industrial R&D. Participation does not guarantee admission, a scholarship, or employment.

## Recruitment process

- Applicants submit a CV and a short introduction.
- The proposed process includes a basic AI assessment, a structured interview about projects and collaboration, and a short research proposal.
- Current audience, deadline, and application URL will be posted after the group confirms them.
